name: tool_search
description: Load tools that are not in your tool list. The system prompt's "Deferred tools" section names them. Pass `names` (exact names, at most 8, all you need at once): the result holds each tool's full schema and the tools are in your tool list from your next step. `query` (a few words) only lists deferred tools whose name or description match, without loading them.

names.description: Exact names of the deferred tools to load.

query.description: Words to look for in deferred tool names and descriptions (at most 8 matches are listed).
